@mark_k 🔧 Our approach at Semeai_tech

Instead of using an LLM as a monolithic “database + reasoning” engine, we separate the layers:
1.Directive cores — small reasoning modules that define how to interpret, connect, and prioritize inputs.
2.Path network — a graph of semantic routes…

claims_supported: Public project language described separated directive-core and path-network layers by 2025-09-11.
